findings.title: 'No norn command' is worded as 'No command of the delivery tool that started the review'
findings.detail:
AC3 reads 'no norn command'; the craft-skill lint ('is unaware of norn') forbids the word norn in norn-review, so the rule says 'the delivery tool', as norn-retro already does. The meaning holds for an agent inside a norn step; a person should confirm the wording meets the criterion.
